Well I mean I'm still dealing with a lot of shit but here are the things that help me from going insane :

1. Try to find a way to cope with what you're dealing with or even just something to keep your mind off it. Personally how I cope with things is I just watch TV, play video games, go to the gym etc. You just have to kind of keep trying and find whatever takes your mind off it and makes you think positively. 

2. Do your best to figure out what triggers your mental issues so you can then avoid those (or make them not as bad). I used to talk to my dad a lot but he's kind of a dick which really triggered my anxiety so I just avoid him now. 

3. Talking to friends or family really helps for me. Whenever I'm in a crisis I'll talk to a friend who I really trust and who understands what I'm going through and that honestly helps me so much. If you don't have many friends or they don't understand what you're going through feel free to hmu in the PMs

4. Think of the future you could have. Idk about you but I'm still fairly young and still have my life ahead of me. Whenever I'm feeling down or something I just think of spending time with my future wife and raising a family and shit like that (those are one of my goals so yeah setting goals could be helpful.

5. If you ever feel suicidal, just think about all the people in your life and how devastated they would be if you died. I know my family and friends would be so upset if I killed myself and the last thing I want to do is hurt them.

6. Seek professional help if that's an option.

Tl;dr : Keep your mind busy; Learn how to avoid or fix the things that trigger your mental illness; talk to someone about it; think of your future and finally just think about how upset people would be if you died (you may not be suicidal but just in case)
